deviationsFromProduction: HOST: a cloud sandbox VM (Firecracker microVM, Linux 6.18, 4 vCPU, 16 GB RAM, shared tenant). Absolute times are NOT comparable to production hardware; ratios between conditions are the more portable result.

IMAGE BASE: ubuntu:24.04 was pulled from mirror.gcr.io (Google's mirror of Docker Hub) because Docker Hub returned HTTP 429 to this network. Digest sha256:534baea6a22c03a63003dbc8dbe78fe34bc0d7e595d9a9dc9834884ff530eb55.
IMAGE DEVIATION 1: the egress proxy's CA certificate was added to the image trust store so HTTPS downloads work during the build.

IMAGE DEVIATION 2: Node.js 18.19.1 + npm 9.2.0 come from Ubuntu 24.04's own packages instead of NodeSource 18.x, because deb.nodesource.com is blocked by the sandbox egress policy. Same major version as the Dockerfile's NODE_VERSION=18.

IMAGE DEVIATION 3: python-poppler was omitted. Its build downloads pybind11 from github.com, which is blocked. It is used only by the LaTeX-to-SVG math step; the benchmark content has no math, so that step is never reached.

DOCKER DAEMON: started with --iptables=false --bridge=none, so containers have no network. The benchmark content needs none at build time (build.sh only uses the network when a bower.json or package.json is present, and the content has neither).

CONTENT: the book is backend/assets/ila-toolchain (the repo's bundled ILA toolchain/demo project, 749 files, 26 MB), not a math textbook. The README's demo repo (test-repo/course-demo) cannot be used: the container pipeline fails on it with 'No HTML output generated'. Because the content has no equations, the pretex math-image cache cannot show a benefit here.

SERVER BENCHMARK: GitHub is replaced by a local bare git repository (git insteadOf), so ls-remote and clone run for real but without network latency (the code's own comment puts the HEAD check at 1-2 s over the network). GITHUB_PERSONAL_TOKEN is unset, which disables the GitHub-Releases pretex cache restore/save step that production runs before every build.

SERVER BENCHMARK: ENABLE_LOCAL_TEST_MODE=true is set only to disable the 3-builds-per-10-minutes limiter on POST /build/init. The benchmark repository does not match the demo repository, so the production build path runs.

BROWSER BENCHMARK: Pyodide 0.25.0 is served from local disk by request interception because cdn.jsdelivr.net is unreachable here. The 'cold' browser number therefore excludes the network transfer of about 12 MB and is a lower bound for a first-ever visit.

notes: Pyodide 0.25.0 served from local disk by request interception; the cdn.jsdelivr.net download time is excluded.
